title: Unit Distance Problem
exact_target: Among n distinct points in the Euclidean plane, what is the greatest possible number of pairs exactly one unit apart, and how does this maximum grow?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 1383 (GEOM-024). CC BY 4.0.
Will Sawin, \emph{An explicit lower bound for the unit distance problem} (2026), arXiv:2605.20579v1, Theorem 1 and introductory discussion, p. 1.
